item: the HOT tier's mention set is reused for a time derived from what its read cost, and a slow read logs its query plan once
summary: Windows run 2026-11-07: corpus_mention_titles took 8.4 s a call (1,516 calls, 3.5 h) on a build that already had the index-order fix, while a synthetic table of the same shape runs in 9 ms, so the real plan is the missing fact. New MentionCache (one per process, held by the wiki service): a read that took c seconds is reused for c / 0.01 seconds (the read is at most 1 percent of wall time whatever the corpus), keyed by corpus database and limit; a failed read keeps nothing; a read over 1 s logs EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN once per process (table, index and column names only). Not a fix of the plan itself: that waits for the plan from the next bundle.
